svg.aria-label: I work mostly on the backend: APIs, databases, message queues, and the deploy and monitoring setup around them. I also do frontend work, mainly in Angular and React. Almost all of my work lives in private company repos, so what you see here are side projects. I'm moving them to ayule.dev. Outside of work I play drums and guitar.
